entry_surfaces./login: split branded authentication — deep slate governance assurance panel with ledger verification stats left, clean direct credential card right
entry_surfaces./setup: stepped initial bootstrap — single centered high-trust card with admin credential creation and ledger root initialization
entry_surfaces./review: tri-pane triage workspace — filter bar top, findings table/list left, interactive side-by-side diff comparison and action synthesis panel right
entry_surfaces./poison-lab: tactical threat workbench — interactive payload injector top, real-time quarantine inspector with red-annotated attack spans and live KB claim stability comparison bottom
entry_surfaces./ledger: cryptographic audit explorer — document version selector with verified hash-chain timeline, deep version diff viewer, and 1-click admin rollback
entry_surfaces./eval: rigorous benchmark suite — run-test launcher, per-fault precision/recall/F1 matrix table, clean FPR indicator, and synthetic-corpus disclaimer banner
entry_surfaces./audit: immutable event feed — cryptographic action filter, search by doc/hash/user, and expandable block payload viewer
entry_surfaces./admin: governance configuration hub — user role matrix, source domain trust rating table, confidence thresholds slider group, and LLM/Gemini connector status

layouts.content_max_width: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-shadow duration-150 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-150 ease-out

accessibility.color_contrast: All text tokens meet WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1 on solid surfaces, >= 7:1 for dark slate sidebar).
accessibility.screen_readers: aria-live regions for scan triggers, live pipeline counters, and toast notifications. Full aria-labels on icon-only buttons.

LedgerVerifiedBadge.description: Always-visible header pill indicating cryptographic hash-chain integrity

ConfidenceBar.description: 0.0 to 1.0 confidence bar with fixed visual marker lines at 0.40 (human review threshold) and 0.80 (auto-apply threshold)

WordDiffViewer.description: Side-by-side or inline word-level diff component for document comparison and proposed synthesis

PoisonSpanHighlighter.description: Text viewer highlighting injection markers, zero-width spaces, and hidden markup with exact byte offsets

PipelineStrip.description: Horizontal state machine showing doc flow: Ingested -> Quarantined -> Claims Indexed -> Candidate Pairs -> Auto-Fixed -> Awaiting Human

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the theme: Light mode default with crisp slate (#F8FAFC) canvas, stark white panels (#FFFFFF), crisp 1px borders (#E2E8F0), royal indigo (#4F46E5) primary buttons/accents, and emerald/teal (#0D9488 / #059669) for verification & ledger health.
Sidebar: Deep Navy/Slate (#0F172A) with crisp contrasting navigation items, active state indicator in cyan/sky (#38BDF8), and an always-visible app brand with version tag.

Header: Glassmorphic with sticky z-40 positioning, displaying the always-visible Ledger-Verified badge with verified block height, live Auto-Apply toggle switch, quick 'Run Scan' action button, and User Profile / Logout control.
Confidence Bar: Always render marker notches at 0.40 ('Human Review' zone) and 0.80 ('Auto-Apply' zone). Color code: <0.40 red/rose, 0.40-0.79 amber/orange, >=0.80 teal/emerald.

Poison Lab: Provide interactive payload presets (e.g. 'Hidden Prompt Injection', 'Zero-Width Char Exploit', 'Contradictory Claim Spoof', 'System Override'). Highlight detected attack segments with high-visibility red pill backgrounds (#FEE2E2 with #B91C1C text and #EF4444 border).

Review Queue: Include Compare, Genealogy, and Resolve tabs. In Resolve tab, provide one-click 'Accept Proposed Fix', 'Keep Both', 'Hold for Second Reviewer', 'Reject Fix', plus an interactive 'Synthesize New Text' editor with LLM prompt preview.

Ledger & Rollback: Show interactive block list with SHA-256 hashes (e.g. `e3b0c44...`), timestamp, author, previous block hash, and a 'Rollback to this Version' modal dialog for admins with confirmation.

Evaluation Page: Render clear disclaimer banner: 'Note: Synthetic evaluation corpus benchmark metrics reflect offline test suites and not live production variance.' Display Precision, Recall, F1 score cards per fault type (Contradiction, Duplicate, Stale, Unsupported, Prompt Injection).

Seed Data & Demo Corpus: Include a 'Load Demo Corpus' button on the dashboard that pre-populates rich documents across all fault types and attack scenarios for immediate verification and review triage.

Ensure every button, link, input, select, and status chip has a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid='btn-run-scan'`, `data-testid='toggle-auto-apply'`, `data-testid='btn-accept-fix'`).
